findings.claim: Every advertised model alias resolves to its declared immutable model.
findings.contradiction: The public API advertised 14 IDs while SGLang exposed only nram-qwen3-14b-awq. GPT-OSS and DeepSeek aliases returned HTTP 200 and Qwen-generated output relabeled with the requested public ID.

findings.claim: Malformed and unknown controls fail loudly before generation.
findings.contradiction: Of 38 validation probes, 11 generated with HTTP 200 and 5 returned unsafe 5xx responses. Unknown top-level/nested keys, unknown profile, malformed vector/soft/hard shapes, fractional forced ID, NaN/Inf strengths, and a forced-versus-forbidden conflict reached generation.

findings.claim: Disconnect and timeout bound continued generation and state mutation.
findings.contradiction: After closing a stream immediately after the first SSE line, the processor ran all 64 forced steps. A non-stream client timeout likewise ran all 64 steps. The retry succeeded with a fresh scheduler ID.

findings.claim: Ordinary and persona streaming obey the public SSE contract.
findings.contradiction: Persona streaming returned application/json and a non-stream completion. Ordinary baseline/NRAM SSE omitted terminal data: [DONE].

findings.claim: Configuration hash covers all behaviorally relevant state.
findings.contradiction: Prompt, seed, temperature, top_p, response_format, and prompt-steering changes all returned d7db79e95c7f838aeae508ef729766f8339edf5ad32c42a92f7d06ce128d9d5f. The response-format arm sampled different grammar-constrained text without changing the hash.

findings.claim: The comparison route reaches the NRAM processor and fails unsupported controls before generation.
findings.contradiction: Both bounded compare requests returned HTTP 500 because the image lacks the evaluation package. The route had already sent baseline and purported NRAM calls directly to SGLang without a custom processor.

findings.claim: Session profile, intensity, memory, counts, and events affect or truthfully track inference.
findings.contradiction: A peak/intensity-1/memory-enabled session remained byte-for-byte unchanged after a session-bound forced generation: request_count 0, all steering counts 0, and events empty.

findings.claim: Telemetry is causal, complete, and one-to-one joinable with public sampled tokens.
findings.contradiction: Public responses/SSE omit scheduler ID and sampled token ID. telemetry_max_steps=1 omitted the second-step phrase mask entirely. Synthetic provenance labeled all four hard-forced tokens positive_logit_bias and zero forced_injection based on post-response estimates.

findings.claim: MoE outer validation rejects unsupported controls before any generation.
findings.contradiction: A recording engine was called before outer validation; the route overwrites outer NRAM options and overrides each persona generation to 1024 tokens, then forces synthesis to at least 1024 tokens.

findings.claim: Numerical controls and token IDs are validated against tokenizer-defined IDs before generation.
findings.contradiction: Active concept NaN strength caused HTTP 500. Tokenizer-undefined model padding ID 151700 was accepted with HTTP 200 for vector, soft, and hard controls.

findings.claim: Committed artifact manifests validate cross-platform against Git object bytes and identify the target tree.
findings.contradiction: The builder manifest identifies starting commit 7aa1285, not the target. Only 3 of 46 expected hashes match target Git blob bytes; all 46 match the CRLF working copies.

findings.claim: Runtime remains available through the bounded campaign.
findings.contradiction: Both containers exited with code 137 after numerical probes; Docker reported OOMKilled=false and API logged graceful shutdown. External cause was not attributable. Existing containers were restarted and restored healthy.

findings.claim: Phrase blocking handles leading-space/no-space tokenizer variants.
findings.contradiction: The exact leading-space encoding of ' thank you' was blocked at token 498, but configuring 'thank you' did not block the same generated leading-space phrase.

bounded_claims_not_falsified: Direct unsupported-feature keys in the explicit allowlist returned stable HTTP 400 before processor events for 14 tested keys.
Forced token 9702 produced decoded 'thank' twice while disabled controls produced 'Okay' twice, with one processor event and unique scheduler ID per request.
Forced-token enabled/disabled behavior survived a cold restart of the same container and image IDs.
Exact phrase completion masking and exact eight-token source-continuation masking occurred at the pre-sampling boundary while disabled controls completed the forced schedules.
Sparse vocabulary-vector sign reversal/zero control and soft-bias sign reversal/zero control produced the requested causal deltas in processor telemetry.
Nine observed entropy PID steps were finite and moved entropy toward their configured targets; request integrals restarted from fresh first-step values.
Seven requests sharing one spoofed application request ID received seven unique scheduler IDs and invocation_count reset to one.
Tracked target test modules collected 216 tests and passed 216 locally; this is not a clean-worktree runtime proof.
limits: No unavailable-model/tokenizer destructive outage probe was performed.
No live MoE request was run because production overrides bounded max_tokens to five generations of at least 1024 tokens.
Grammar all-mask composition, Czech Unicode normalization, capsules, retries, queued cancellation, failed MCP, and unavailable activation-vector paths remain incomplete.
No broad multi-prompt/multi-seed research-validity campaign or confidence intervals were run.
The unexpected exit-137 event has no proven causal relationship to the probes.
The D: volume briefly reached zero free bytes; one redundant exact spec copy was deleted after its hash and Git blob identity had been recorded.
